name: TypeScript Type Check
description: Runs tsc --noEmit after writing/editing .ts/.tsx files. Catches type errors before they compound.

name: Python Type Check
description: Runs pyright on the edited Python file. Catches type mismatches early.

name: Python Lint (ruff)
description: Runs ruff lint on edited Python files. Fast alternative to flake8/pylint.

name: JS/TS Lint (eslint)
description: Runs eslint on edited JS/TS files. Catches style and logic issues.

name: Auto-format (prettier)
description: Auto-formats frontend files after edit. Keeps consistent style without manual intervention.

name: Auto-format (ruff format)
description: Auto-formats Python files after edit. Drop-in replacement for black, much faster.

name: Large File Guard
command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_file_path"; CONTENT="$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_content"; LINES=$(echo "$CONTENT" | wc -l); if [ "$LINES" -gt 800 ]; then echo "BLOCK: Writing $LINES lines to $FILE exceeds 800-line limit. Split into smaller files." >&2; exit 1; fi'
description: Blocks writes over 800 lines, enforcing the small-file convention. Prevents monolith files.

name: Test Before Commit
command: bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_command"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "^git commit"; then echo "WARN: Running tests before commit is recommended. Consider running the test suite first." >&2; fi; true'
description: Warns (non-blocking) when git commit is attempted, reminding to run tests first.

name: Python Project Guard (template)
command:
bash -c '# Customize: add project-specific command guards here
# Example: block direct pip install without --dry-run
CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_command"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "pip install(?!.*--dry-run)"; then echo "BLOCK: Use pip install --dry-run first" >&2; exit 1; fi; true'
description: Template for project-level Python guards. Install in .claude/settings.json of a specific project. Customize the command pattern for your domain.

name: ML Experiment Guard (template)
command:
bash -c '# Customize: enforce dry-run, require GPU flags, etc.
CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_command"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "(train|launch)" && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -q "dry.run"; then echo "BLOCK: Add --dry-run flag for first run" >&2; exit 1; fi; true'
description: Template for ML project experiment guards. Enforces dry-run before real training runs. Customize patterns for your launcher.
